test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The diameter of a metallic solid sphere is 42 cm. It is melted and drawn into a wire with a cross-sectional diameter of 0.6 cm. Find the length (in metre) of the wire.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of **sphere** = Volume of **cylindrical wire**

(4/3) × π × R³ = π × r² × L

(4/3) × 21 × 21 × 21 = 0.3 × 0.3 × L (all in cm)

L = (4 × 7 × 21 × 21) ÷ 0.09 = 137200 cm = 1372 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1372 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of **sphere** (D) = 42 cm ⇒ Radius (R) = 21 cm

Diameter of **wire** (d) = 0.6 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 0.3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **sphere** = (4/3) × π × R³

Volume of **cylinder** (wire) = π × r² × h (where h is the length L)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60bb335a490cbe3da8fbcef57512325b8c1dfaffffc1cc4b24a1ffca1e127c72.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of **sphere** = Volume of **wire**

⇒ (4/3) × π × (21)³ = π × (0.3)² × L

⇒ (4/3) × 21 × 21 × 21 = 0.09 × L

⇒ 4 × 7 × 441 = 0.09 × L

⇒ 12348 = 0.09 × L

⇒ L = 12348 ÷ 0.09 = 137200 cm

⇒ L (in metre) = 137200 ÷ 100 = 1372 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1372 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Invariance

When a solid is **melted** and recast into a new shape, the **total volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage.

Cylinder Properties

For a **wire** (cylinder), the curved surface area is 2πrh and the total surface area is 2πr(h + r).

Unit Conversion

1 **metre** = 100 **centimetres**. Always ensure all dimensions are in the same system before calculation.</p
